newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-OVERSLEEPING ROMARIO LATE FOR TRAINING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OVERSLEEPING ROMARIO LATE FOR TRAINING.

text.p: Troubled Brazilian striker Romario opened a new chapter in his conflict with Valencia coach Luis Aragones after arriving an hour and a quarter late for training on Thursday.
Romario, who returned from a five-day trip to Brazil on Tuesday, told reporters that he had overslept.

Aragones dropped Romario on several occasions earlier this season after complaining that the Brazilian did not train hard enough. Romario, 30, commented last week that he was too old to train like the other players.
